findings_retained_from_v1.rule: C/Hyperposition probe decodability is representation evidence, not final functional acceptance; require behavioral/OOD use and matched causal-use evidence at the strongest exposed interface before causal promotion.
Checkpoint evaluation must distinguish shallow shortcut acquisition from systematic variable binding using nuisance-only, hop/depth, unseen-symbol/permutation and mechanism-sensitive controls.
Treat Hyperposition as structured branch-state/set information; use rank-aware representation tests. A single steering vector can be a component probe, not the ontology.
Activation/subspace patching requires off-target/alternate-site/lesion-shuffle-rescue and re-entry controls before faithful-mechanism claims.

A failed linear probe/intervention narrows only the linear hypothesis; it does not prove feature absence. Any nonlinear successor must be preregistered on fresh data, never post-hoc fit to a frozen holdout.
Hyperposition state transitions should be equivariant to nuisance branch-ID renaming/order permutations when semantic relations are preserved.
